methods.bm25_and_expanded: Native retrieval functions; page and exact gold-phrase-containing chunk rank recorded.
methods.candidate_depth: Direct retrieval and simulated extractive selection tested depths 20/40/80; actual QA run confirms mode-specific output.
methods.metadata_rerank: Expanded top-80 rescored with section lexical overlap 0.001 and title overlap 0.0005 per token.
methods.page_unique: Expanded top-80 collapsed to first-ranked unique SHA/page pairs before top-20 recall.
methods.metadata_scope: Every variant retains original_pdf source-type filter; no gold paper/title is used to filter candidates.

limitations: 仅使用公开开发组；不读取 PT15、PT9、PT12 或冻结 gold。
候选召回和 extractive phrase containment 不代表语义正确率。
metadata_rerank 权重是诊断性对照，未经新数据验证。
